data.description:
Sibling of bug a3f5-5c19-faad-417b (found in its Step-7 construct sweep); same class as 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee.

Mechanism: orchestrator.delivered_children_manifest (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:~151) loops a container's children and calls attest.delivered_now -> _attested_delivered -> compute_validity(sig, child, 'completion-verifier') per closed child; the completion branch recomputes current_material_fingerprint (1 full-store reduce via live_material_children) and on mismatch retries 3 legacy generations — O(N)..O(4N)+ full-store scans per Pass-2 completion sub-call manifest assembly. It also does a per-child full show_ticket read (separate, lighter concern).

Proposed fix (same remedy shape as 3d57 / a3f5): open 'with material_child_index(repo_root=repo_root):' around the delivered_now loop in delivered_children_manifest so every child fingerprint answers from one shared snapshot. Counting-seam regression test template: tests/unit/test_completion_child_gate_scan_count.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Full-store reduce count during delivered_children_manifest does not grow with child count (counting-seam test).
- [ ] Delivered manifest contents byte-identical before/after on a fixture store.
- [ ] make lint + typecheck + complexity ratchet clean.
data.title: delivered-children manifest scans full store per child (delivered_now)
